name: API Connection example code
description: Example code for the API Connection module.
project_description: Hidden example submodule of API Connection demonstrating a working RestApiConnection integration against the public ReqRes.in service. It ships one connection plugin (ReqRes, id 'req_res') with getUser() and login() methods over sendRequest(), and a controller with two routes that render example user data and a login token. Intended purely as reference code for developers building their own connection plugins; not for production use.
